onboarding.welcomeIntro: Welcome to Keep, {{username}}. Before you start, we need you to complete the initial setup process. This will help us personalize your experience and make sure everything is ready for you.

steps.workspaceDescription: Choose where to store your files

intro.headline: Your files, in order — and accessible from the whole suite
intro.subheadline: 1 minute to set up. After that, it just works.
intro.value1Description: Folders, favorites, and recents — not a junk drawer.
intro.value2Description: By name and by content, not just the file title.
intro.value3Description: One day to recover anything you deleted by mistake.
intro.value4Description: Upload a file and it shows up right away on all your devices.
intro.value5Title: Connected to the rest of the suite
intro.value5Description: Share folders across your apps without duplicating anything.

help.pageSubtitle: Learn how to use all of Keep's features
help.footer: This is your personal instance of Keep

workspace.title: What is a Workspace?
workspace.text: A Workspace is an independent file space with its own root folder. Think of it as a separate "drive": what you upload in one workspace doesn't mix with what you upload in another.
list: Every user gets a default workspace when they sign up
You can create several workspaces to separate contexts (for example, personal and work)
Folders and files in each workspace are independent of one another
workspace.tip: Switch workspaces from the selector in the top bar, next to the logo. To create a new one, choose "Create workspace" at the end of the list.

navigation.title: Navigating folders
navigation.text: The file explorer shows the full folder tree on the left and the contents of the current folder on the right.
list: Click a folder in the side tree, or a folder card, to enter it
The breadcrumb at the top shows where you are and lets you go back to a previous folder
On mobile, the folder tree opens with the "Folders" button
navigation.tip: Use the search bar at the top to jump straight to a file or folder by name, without navigating folder by folder.

upload.title: Uploading files
upload.text: There are several ways to upload files to the folder you're currently in.
list1: "Upload file" button in the folder sidebar
Drag and drop one or more files onto the screen
On mobile, tapping the empty background of the content panel opens the file picker
list2: Images and videos aren't allowed — they're managed in Immich, not Keep
Each file has a maximum allowed size
Uploads are processed several at a time, but with a concurrency limit to avoid overloading the server
upload.tip: If you upload many files at once and some fail, you'll see a notice indicating how many couldn't be uploaded, without affecting the rest.
upload.tipMedia: This isn't a broken limitation: Keep is for important documents you don't want to lose (PDFs, contracts, notes), not your photo library. Photos and videos have their own app in the suite, Immich, built for that.

organize.title: Organize: create, move, rename and delete
list: Right-click on a folder's background and choose "New folder" to add a subfolder
Drag a file or folder card and drop it onto another folder (in the panel or in the side tree) to move it
Right-click on a file or folder for "Rename", "Download" or "Delete"
organize.tip: Deleting a folder also deletes everything inside it. This can't be undone, so the app asks you to confirm before applying it.

selection.title: Multiple selection
selection.text: You can select several files or folders at once to download or delete them together.
list: Hover over a card (or tap it on mobile) to see the selection checkbox in the top-left corner
With at least one item selected, a bar appears with the available actions: Download, Delete and an option to clear the selection
selection.tip: The selection is cleared automatically when you switch folders.

share.title: Sharing files
share.text: A file can be shared with other applications so they can access it directly, without having to download it and upload it again by hand.
list: Right-click on a file and choose "Share with"
Choose the target application from the submenu
A small avatar on the file card shows which apps it's shared with
To stop sharing it, go back to the same submenu and choose "Stop sharing with"
share.tip: This option only appears for users with the administrator role.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.text: Star the files or folders you use often so you can find them without navigating to them.
list: Hover over a card (or tap it on mobile) and click the star to mark it as a favorite
"Favorites", in the sidebar, gathers everything you've starred into one view, regardless of which folder it's in
favorites.tip: A favorite still lives in its original folder — starring it doesn't move it, it just adds it to this view.

recent.title: Recent
recent.text: "Recent", in the sidebar, shows the files you've opened or downloaded most recently, so you don't have to remember which folder you left them in.
list: Sorted by last access, not upload date
Only opening or downloading a file counts — browsing a folder that contains it doesn't make it show up here

trash.title: Trash
trash.text: Deleting a file or folder doesn't remove it instantly — it goes to the trash first.
list: "Trash", in the sidebar, lists everything deleted and awaiting permanent removal
Select one or more items and use "Restore" to send them back to their original folder
trash.tip: Items in the trash are permanently deleted the day after being sent here — restore before that window closes.

upload.title: Your file tree
upload.description: Here you'll see all your folders, and you can upload new files with this button, or just by dragging them onto the screen.

search.title: Search by name and content
search.description: Search files and folders by name, and also inside the content of your plain-text (.txt) and Markdown (.md) notes, without navigating folder by folder.

favorites.title: Favorites and Recent
favorites.description: Mark your important files as favorites to find them quickly, or check the ones you opened recently from "Recent".

storage.title: Storage usage
storage.description: Here you can see how much space you're using against your workspace's quota.

viewToggle.title: Grid or list view
viewToggle.description: Switch between viewing your files as cards or as a list, and sort by name, size, or date with the selector next to it.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Anything you delete goes here before it's gone for good — you have until the next day to restore it.

share.title: Sharing files
share.description: From a file's context menu (right-click) you can share it with other apps in the suite, like Movements.

help.title: Need more help?
help.description: Find this guide and more details anytime from your profile icon (top right) → Help.
